comments.author: @TheEarthEngineOfficial
comments.text: The money-as-thread framing is what makes this work — following the receipts from the Louisiana Purchase to the gold window closing turns an abstract 'empire without colonies' into something you can actually trace. I was struck by the 1971 turning point in particular: once the dollar was no longer tied to gold, did the empire's power become more financial than territorial, or is that a false divide?
